- Blockers: quota increase for us-west1 still pending (ticket #INC-224), spot eviction tail causing transient 429s on small jobs.

kevin: small note — adding this command to run the stress job:
```
kubectl run gpu-stress --image=redwood/gpu-bench:latest --requests=cpu=2,memory=4Gi,nvidia.com/gpu=1 --restart=Never -- /bin/bash -c "python bench.py --threads 8"
```
maria: perfect. That's all from me. :coffee:
